title: Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly
plot_overview: An athlete never expected to reach the Olympics, but her performance at the 2024 Paris Games suddenly goes viral. As memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories spread, the documentary explores the attention and questions surrounding her path to the competition.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you’re interested in Olympic stories, viral moments, and the fallout from online attention; Not for you if you want a consistently flattering portrait or a full account of every perspective.
review_summary: Pros: explores viral attention; includes early perspectives; raises questions about misinformation | Cons: critical portrayal; leaves out context; limited broader perspective
